reports.title: IDEX REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER RESULTS

guidance.heading: Outlook(1)
section: •Full year organic sales projected to increase 6.5% to 6.8% over the prior year, up from previous guidance of 5% to 6%
•Full year adjusted diluted EPS of $8.91 to $8.96, up approximately 12% year-over-year at midpoint, up from previous guidance of $8.70 to $8.85
